meta.title: Aido, find where to help near you
meta.description: Say in a few words what you enjoy, what you're good at and how much time you have. Aido suggests real volunteering missions that fit you.

intro.headline: Tell us how you'd like to help. We'll find where.
intro.lede: Tell us where you are, what you enjoy and how much time you have. We'll find a few missions that fit you.

examples.one: I'm free on Saturday mornings in Lyon 7e and I like working with kids
examples.two: I'm an accountant in Paris and want to put my skills to work for a nonprofit
examples.three: I've never volunteered before, looking for a one-off action in Nantes

composer.placeholder: For example: I live in Lille, I speak English and have two evenings a week

saved.title: Saved missions
saved.empty: Save a mission to find it here. Saved missions stay on this device.

errors.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: That's a lot of messages in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: This conversation got too long. Start a new search.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The mission source isn't responding right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.GEOCODING_FAILED: The location service isn't responding. Try again in a moment.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: Aido's AI service can't be reached right now. Try again in a moment.

footer.attribution: Missions posted on Aido by associations, plus JeVeuxAider.gouv.fr and Service Civique. Aido only shares your contact details with the associations you apply to.
footer.ai: Suggestions are generated by AI and may contain mistakes: the organization always confirms the details.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.lede: Get a sign-in link by email. No password to remember.
auth.sent: Done. Open the email sent to {email} and click the link to continue.
auth.error: The link couldn't be sent. Check the address and try again.
auth.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
auth.linkExpired: That link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.

asso.pitch: Post your missions in two minutes and get applications that are ready to read. No more PDF forms.

onboarding.title: Your organization
onboarding.lede: Enter your RNA number (W followed by 9 digits) or your SIREN. We check it against the official register.
onboarding.label: RNA or SIREN
onboarding.notFound: No active organization matches this number.
onboarding.invalid: This doesn't look like an RNA (W123456789) or SIREN (9 digits).
onboarding.inactive: This organization is closed in the register.
onboarding.notNonprofit: This organization isn't an association or nonprofit.
onboarding.unavailable: The official register isn't responding. Try again in a moment.
onboarding.conflict: This organization already has an Aido account. Contact the person who created it.
onboarding.demoFound: Test number: demo organization, not verified. Available in development only.

asso.verifiedHint: Existence checked in the official French business and association register

dashboard.empty: No missions yet. Describe what you need and the AI takes care of the formatting.

dashboard.pending: {count, plural, =0 {} one {# to review} other {# to review}}

missionComposer.title: Post a mission
missionComposer.lede: Describe what you need like you would to a friend, or drop your old PDF form. AI writes the mission and a short form to replace it.
missionComposer.describePlaceholder: E.g. We need volunteers on Tuesday evenings for the food distribution at 12 rue de la Roquette…
missionComposer.pdf: Old form or mission sheet (PDF, optional)
missionComposer.reviewLede: Everything can be edited. What you see is what volunteers will see.
missionComposer.questionsLede: This short form replaces your PDF. Name, email and phone already come from Aido.

errors.tooShort: Describe what you need in a few sentences, or add a PDF.
errors.pdfInvalid: The file must be a PDF under 8 MB.
errors.ai: AI couldn't write the mission. Try again.
errors.publish: The mission couldn't be posted. Check the fields and try again.

applicants.empty: No applications yet. They'll appear here as soon as a volunteer applies through Aido.
applicants.sendFailed: The message couldn't be sent. Try again.
applicants.publishedBody: It now shows at the top of volunteers' searches around {city}, with the "Apply on Aido" button. Applications will arrive here.
applicants.publishedBodyNoCity: It now shows in volunteers' searches, with the "Apply on Aido" button. Applications will arrive here.
applicants.formHint: First name, city, email and phone are added automatically.

apply.title: Apply
apply.prefilling: Aido is pre-filling your application from the conversation…
apply.prefilled: Pre-filled from your conversation. Check and complete it.
apply.signInFirst: To send your application, enter your email. You'll get a sign-in link, then come back here.
apply.motivation: A few words for the organization
apply.done: Application sent to {organization}. You'll follow their reply in "My applications".
apply.conflict: You've already applied to this mission.
apply.error: The application couldn't be sent. Try again.
apply.draftLede: Written by Aido from your conversation. Check it, fill any gaps, then send.
apply.signInToSend: Last step: enter your email so {organization} can reply. You'll come back here after clicking the link.
apply.notInApp: This mission is no longer on Aido.
